snippet.title: Sigma Star Saga DX - Launch Trailer - AVAILABLE NOW!
snippet.description: Sigma Star Saga DX, an updated version of the classic shoot-'em-up/RPG, is available now on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and Steam! Side-scrolling space-shooter battles meet top-down exploration in this sci-fi epic featuring more than 15,000 Gun Data combinations! Infiltrate the invading alien empire, investigate six planets, power up with awesome tools, and enjoy bonus features like an art gallery and jukebox. The fate of the stars is in your hands! Get more info at: https://wayforward.com/games/sigma-star-saga-dx
